reason: It's literally at my subway exit and I'm grabbing something to go anyway, so I'd try the plain matcha latte once and maybe the cherry pie one out of curiosity. But Matchaful is right there and I already know their matcha is good, so this has to earn a spot.
objection: Strawberry cheesecake and cherry pie matcha sounds like syrup hiding mediocre powder. They don't say what matcha they use, and $7-8 for a takeaway cup with barely anywhere to sit isn't a deal when I have a place I trust a block away.
would_change_my_mind: If they named a good ceremonial-grade source and the plain matcha latte actually tasted grassy and smooth, not bitter or sugary, I'd switch my weekday stop since it's right at the train.
